# Bootable-system critical path.
# gentoo-kernel-bin = Gentoo's prebuilt kernel. No config archaeology, and it
# arrives as a binary package. You are writing a desktop, not a kernel.
sys-kernel/gentoo-kernel-bin
sys-kernel/linux-firmware
sys-kernel/installkernel
sys-kernel/dracut
sys-apps/systemd
app-admin/sudo
net-misc/networkmanager
net-wireless/iwd
app-portage/gentoolkit
app-portage/eix

# FFmpeg stack (mpv / VLC / Firefox / Qt Multimedia)
media-video/ffmpeg
dev-qt/qtmultimedia

# GStreamer stack (GTK apps, gst pipelines). ugly = patent-encumbered,
# bad = less-mature, libav = the FFmpeg bridge. All four needed for
# "everything just plays".
media-libs/gst-plugins-base
media-libs/gst-plugins-good
media-libs/gst-plugins-bad
media-libs/gst-plugins-ugly
media-plugins/gst-plugins-libav

# Hardware video acceleration + the tool to verify it (vainfo)
media-libs/libva
media-video/libva-utils

# Players
media-video/mpv
media-video/vlc

# =====================================================================
#  "Just works" extras. Unblocked by ACCEPT_LICENSE="*".
# =====================================================================

# Binary Firefox — source firefox is a 1.5-3 hour build on this box for
# zero practical gain. This is the pragmatic choice.
www-client/firefox-bin

# Microsoft core fonts (EULA-gated, now accepted) + metric-compatible
# Liberation set. Without these, a lot of the web and many documents
# render with wrong metrics.
media-fonts/corefonts
media-fonts/liberation-fonts

# Everyday archive handling
app-arch/7zip
app-arch/unzip

# Flatpak — the sane route for proprietary desktop apps (Discord, Spotify,
# Slack) without fighting ebuilds for them.
sys-apps/flatpak

# GPU verification tools: vulkaninfo / glxinfo, for confirming RADV and
# radeonsi actually came up after first boot.
dev-util/vulkan-tools
x11-apps/mesa-progs
dev-util/ccache

kde-plasma/plasma-meta
kde-apps/dolphin
kde-apps/konsole
kde-apps/kate
kde-apps/ark
kde-apps/gwenview
kde-plasma/spectacle
kde-apps/okular
kde-apps/kcalc

# =====================================================================
#  LXQt desktop — Qt6, genuinely lightweight, almost no KDE stack.
#  Only KDE thing pulled in: breeze-icons (SVG icon theme, no code).
# =====================================================================
lxqt-base/lxqt-meta

# Window managers. LXQt's own +window-manager USE would drag in KWin AND
# kde-plasma/systemsettings, so it is disabled and we pick our own.
# openbox = X11 session (stable, LXQt's traditional WM)
# labwc   = Wayland session (wlroots, openbox-like)
x11-wm/openbox
gui-wm/labwc

# X11 server + amdgpu DDX for the openbox session; XWayland for the rest
x11-base/xorg-server
x11-base/xorg-drivers
x11-base/xwayland

# Audio
media-video/pipewire
media-video/wireplumber

# Fonts
media-fonts/noto
media-fonts/noto-emoji
media-fonts/dejavu

# Dev tooling
dev-build/cmake
dev-build/ninja
dev-vcs/git
app-editors/neovim
